name: Sudan
note: Each claim is one rendered observation on the canonical page. claims.title: The Kerma culture
claims.summary: The city-state of Kerma dominates the middle Nile, one of the earliest urban civilisations in sub-Saharan Africa and a rival of pharaonic Egypt.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-2400bce-the-kerma-culture, claim TL:SDN:event:2400bce:the-kerma-culture, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Kush independent at Napata
claims.summary: As Egypt's New Kingdom collapses, Kush re-emerges as an independent kingdom centred on Napata, near Gebel Barkal.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1070bce-kush-independent-at-napata, claim TL:SDN:event:1070bce:kush-independent-at-napata, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Piye conquers Egypt — the 25th Dynasty
claims.summary: The Kushite king Piye (Piankhi) brings Egypt under Nubian rule, founding the 25th Dynasty of "Black Pharaohs"; Taharqa later reigns at its height.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-727bce-piye-conquers-egypt-the-25th-dynasty, claim TL:SDN:event:727bce:piye-conquers-egypt-the-25th-dynasty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Assyrians expel the Kushites from Egypt
claims.summary: Esarhaddon and then Ashurbanipal invade Egypt, driving the Kushite pharaohs back to Nubia by the 660s BCE.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-671bce-assyrians-expel-the-kushites-from-egypt, claim TL:SDN:event:671bce:assyrians-expel-the-kushites-from-egypt, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Capital moves to Meroe
claims.summary: After Psamtik II of Egypt sacks Napata, the Kushite court shifts south to Meroe, beginning the Meroitic age of iron, script and pyramids.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-591bce-capital-moves-to-meroe, claim TL:SDN:event:591bce:capital-moves-to-meroe, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Nubia converts to Christianity
claims.summary: Nobatia, Makuria and Alodia adopt Christianity, partly through missions linked to the Byzantine court; the Nubian Nile becomes a Christian realm.

sources.label: Christian Nubia and Muslim Egypt Sign Treaty

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-550-nubia-converts-to-christianity, claim TL:SDN:event:550:nubia-converts-to-christianity, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Baqt treaty
claims.summary: After repelling an Arab invasion, Makuria and Muslim Egypt agree to the Baqt, a durable pact of non-aggression and regulated trade.

sources.label: Christian Nubia and Muslim Egypt Sign Treaty

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-652-the-baqt-treaty, claim TL:SDN:event:652:the-baqt-treaty, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Decline of Makuria
claims.summary: Under Mamluk pressure and Arab settlement, the Christian kingdom of Makuria fragments and its capital at Dongola is lost.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1317-decline-of-makuria, claim TL:SDN:event:1317:decline-of-makuria, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Fall of Alodia
claims.summary: The last Christian Nubian kingdom, Alodia, collapses as new Muslim powers rise on the central Nile, ending Nubian Christianity's long ascendancy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1504-fall-of-alodia, claim TL:SDN:event:1504:fall-of-alodia, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Funj Sultanate founded at Sennar
claims.summary: Amara Dunqas establishes the Funj Sultanate, a Muslim confederation centred on Sennar on the Blue Nile.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1504-funj-sultanate-founded-at-sennar, claim TL:SDN:event:1504:funj-sultanate-founded-at-sennar, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Sultanate of Darfur founded
claims.summary: Sulayman Solong founds the Keira dynasty in the west; under Ahmad Bukr Islam becomes the state religion.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1650-sultanate-of-darfur-founded, claim TL:SDN:event:1650:sultanate-of-darfur-founded, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Sennar at its height
claims.summary: The Funj capital flourishes as one of the major trading cities of the African interior, dealing in gold, ivory and enslaved people.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1690-sennar-at-its-height, claim TL:SDN:event:1690:sennar-at-its-height, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Darfur's capital fixed at al-Fashir
claims.summary: The Keira sultans establish al-Fashir as their capital; Darfur controls caravan routes across the Sahara.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1792-darfur-s-capital-fixed-at-al-fashir, claim TL:SDN:event:1792:darfur-s-capital-fixed-at-al-fashir, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Turco-Egyptian conquest; Khartoum founded
claims.summary: Muhammad Ali's armies conquer the Sudan; Khartoum is founded c. 1821 at the junction of the Blue and White Niles as the seat of Egyptian rule.

sources.label: History of Sudan — Egyptian-Ottoman rule over the Sudan

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1820-turco-egyptian-conquest-khartoum-founded, claim TL:SDN:event:1820:turco-egyptian-conquest-khartoum-founded, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Muhammad Ahmad proclaims himself the Mahdi
claims.summary: A religious teacher declares himself the awaited redeemer and launches a holy war against Turco-Egyptian rule.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1881-muhammad-ahmad-proclaims-himself-the-mahdi, claim TL:SDN:event:1881:muhammad-ahmad-proclaims-himself-the-mahdi, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Fall of Khartoum; death of Gordon
claims.summary: Mahdist forces storm Khartoum after a long siege and kill General Charles Gordon; the Mahdi dies months later.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1885-fall-of-khartoum-death-of-gordon, claim TL:SDN:event:1885:fall-of-khartoum-death-of-gordon, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Battle of Omdurman
claims.summary: Kitchener's Anglo-Egyptian army destroys the Khalifa's forces with overwhelming firepower, ending the Mahdist state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1898-battle-of-omdurman, claim TL:SDN:event:1898:battle-of-omdurman, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Anglo-Egyptian Condominium established
claims.summary: Sudan is placed under joint British and Egyptian rule by the Condominium agreements of January and July 1899.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1899-anglo-egyptian-condominium-established, claim TL:SDN:event:1899:anglo-egyptian-condominium-established, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Independence of the Sudan
claims.summary: Sudan becomes a sovereign republic, ending Anglo-Egyptian rule; its parliament chooses independence over union with Egypt.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1956-independence-of-the-sudan, claim TL:SDN:event:1956:independence-of-the-sudan, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: First civil war
claims.summary: Rebellion in the south, begun in 1955, grows into a 17-year war ended by the Addis Ababa Agreement of 27 February 1972, which grants southern autonomy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1955-first-civil-war, claim TL:SDN:event:1955:first-civil-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Second civil war begins
claims.summary: Nimeiri scraps southern autonomy and imposes sharia; the SPLM/A under John Garang launches a war that kills an estimated two million people.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1983-second-civil-war-begins, claim TL:SDN:event:1983:second-civil-war-begins, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Bashir seizes power
claims.summary: Omar al-Bashir takes power in an Islamist-backed military coup, beginning a three-decade rule.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-1989-bashir-seizes-power, claim TL:SDN:event:1989:bashir-seizes-power, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Comprehensive Peace Agreement
claims.summary: The 2005 accord ends the second civil war, grants the south autonomy, and promises a referendum on independence.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-2005-comprehensive-peace-agreement, claim TL:SDN:event:2005:comprehensive-peace-agreement, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: War in Darfur begins
claims.summary: Rebel attacks meet a government-backed Janjaweed campaign; UN estimates put the toll at about 300,000 dead and some three million displaced.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-2003-war-in-darfur-begins, claim TL:SDN:event:2003:war-in-darfur-begins, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: ICC indicts Bashir
claims.summary: The International Criminal Court issues warrants for President al-Bashir for war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide — the first against a sitting head of state.

sources.label: ICC Issues Arrest Warrant for Sudanese President Bashir

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-2009-icc-indicts-bashir, claim TL:SDN:event:2009:icc-indicts-bashir, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: South Sudan secedes
claims.summary: After a referendum, South Sudan becomes independent, taking most of the former Sudan's oil with it.

sources.label: Referendum in Southern Sudan / Independence of South Sudan
sources.publisher: United Nations Mission in the Sudan (UNMIS)

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-2011-south-sudan-secedes, claim TL:SDN:event:2011:south-sudan-secedes, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Revolution ousts Bashir
claims.summary: Months of mass protests prompt the military to remove Omar al-Bashir after three decades in power.

sources.label: Sudan: With al-Bashir Ouster, End Authoritarianism

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-2019-revolution-ousts-bashir, claim TL:SDN:event:2019:revolution-ousts-bashir, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: War between SAF and RSF
claims.summary: Fighting erupts between the army under al-Burhan and the RSF under "Hemedti", spreading nationwide and causing mass death, displacement and famine.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sudan: Land of Kush and the confluence of the Niles, from the Black Pharaohs to a republic at war.", terralore.co/country/SDN/chronicle#ev-2023-war-between-saf-and-rsf, claim TL:SDN:event:2023:war-between-saf-and-rsf, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
